textureBake.method: watlas UV unwrap + outward-normal source surface albedo transfer

surfaceCleanup.method: Outward closed-volume reconstruction; bounded surface reduction and source-color rebake

contactFit.reason: Fit actual muzzle and soles to existing gameplay anchors; normals inverse-transposed. No ecology or combat changes.

neutralRepair.method: Smooth offline rump-axis tail shear; normals inverse-transposed. No runtime counterrotation.

normalRepair: Area-weighted shared surface normals; three adjacency smoothing steps across UV seams

atlasSliverRepair.method: Restore tiny atlas-rejected triangle with duplicated UV-local vertices and matching outward boundary winding
